$comment: The compatibility record for the Munarium client libraries. Generated and maintained by hand at release time. Update this file, never the historical notes in README.md, which are a dated changelog of what was true when they were written.
policy: Each Clients minor release supports the current Server minor and the one before it (N and N-1). A breaking MMP wire change bumps mmp_contract_major; Server serves both majors for one Server minor release so Clients can move without a flag day. Clients version independently of Server: a shared version number on a given release is a coincidence of that release, not a rule.
note: Server client packages 1.1.0 add the complete named ServerApiClient over REST and gRPC for Server 1.2.0. Existing typed planes retain the 1.1 baseline; the complete gRPC service and collection vocabulary/answer APIs require Server 1.2. Matrix client packages move to 1.1.1 with the Server clients (no API change; Matrix compatibility unchanged at 1.0). The Rust client depends on the Server wire crates munarium-proto and munarium-api-types, published to crates.io at 1.2.1 on 2026-09-15. The current checkout targets Server 1.3.0 with the declared N/N-1 range 1.3/1.2 for release qualification; these are source targets, not a claim that published SDK artifacts changed. The release checklist requires client conformance before publication. Checkout Rust clients use local 1.3.0 wire crates; SDK package versions and Matrix compatibility are unchanged.
